concentration_basis_evidence.interpretation: The fitting response is the OH_Conc_ppm column divided by1e6. The paper calls X(OH) a mole fraction. We reproduce the notebook scaling; the pooled Sossi columns require clarification before literal OH atomic conversion.

coefficients.source: Table4 second row, rounded posterior means
coefficients.covariance_status: Not supplied as numerical posterior samples or covariance in the downloaded dataset files; do not assume independent coefficients.
coefficients.A_uncertainty: Author de-scaling constant, not a fitted uncertain intercept.

sossi_2023.note: Both absorption alternatives remain archived. The combined OH column numerically uses H2O_ppm_mean * M_OH/M_H2O. If the raw column means H2O mass ppm, literal two-OH-group counting gives twice this value. No source correction is made; spectroscopy/equivalent-species conventions remain to be clarified.

newcombe_2017.title: Solubility of water in lunar basalt at low pH2O

uncertainties.H2_molecular_calibration: Not established by these OH observations.
uncertainties.melt_metal_H_standard: Not calibrated by this OH fit.
uncertainties.pooled_response_to_atomic_amounts: Unresolved; factor-of-two arithmetic discrepancy conditional on literal H2O/OH mass interpretations.

scope.text_recommendation: Section4.2: ~1600-2100K, <=~1kbar; conclusion: up to2200K and ~100bar. Neither is a joint experimental rectangular domain.
scope.external_pressure_comparison: Paper reports agreement within a factor of2 against Shishkina2010 basalt at1250C up to1kbar; those data are not independently replayed here.
